questions.question: Explain Business.
questions.solution_html:

  • o Apply for company name approval under RUN or SPICe+ Part A.

  • Meaning
  • • A sole proprietorship is the simplest form of business, owned, managed, and controlled
  • by a single individual.
  • • The proprietor has full authority, enjoys all profits, and bears all losses.
  • • It is common in retail, small services, and local businesses.
  • Merits of Sole Proprietorship
  • Ease of Formation
  • o Simple registration; inexpensive and quick to start.
  • Unlimited Liability
  • o Personal assets may be used to pay business debts.
  • Features
  • Division-Based Structure – Each division operates as a semi-independent unit.
  • Improved Decision-Making
  • o Quick and flexible as authority is decentralised.
  • Costly Structure
  • o Each division requires its own resources, increasing expenses.
  • Meaning
  • • The Articles of Association (AOA) is a primary legal document that defines the internal
  • rules and regulations governing a company’s management.
  • • It details rights, duties, powers, and procedures for running the company.
  • • It is subordinate to the Memorandum of Association (MOA).
  • Main Contents of AOA
  • Share Capital and Rights
  • o Types of shares, rights of shareholders, issue and transfer of shares.
